_about: The Sewer under Garathorm (levels 1-18): rats that swarm to each other's squeal, wererats, the mindflayers' colony (the master mindflayer, a sub-boss), basilisks, a hag and an otyugh as elites, and the Rat King in the deep Square Lair, spitting plague and calling his swarm.

72000.name: rat king
72000.long_desc: The Rat King squats on a throne of filth, a crown of bent spoons on his matted head.
72000.description: A rat the size of a man, grey-furred and pink-eyed, his tail knotted with a dozen smaller rats' tails into a writhing mass. Plague drips from his yellow teeth, and every rat in the sewer is his subject.

phases.message: The Rat King hurls his crown aside: "My children! Feast!"
